C1.worst_defect: Nothing near the top says who should NOT pick this over Shopify POS/Square/Lightspeed: integrated card terminals, cash drawers, direct receipt printers and non-Chrome browsers are unsupported, but you only learn that from the 'Before you start' bullets after ten equal-weight feature cards.

C2.worst_defect: The site leans on 'open-source' and 'MIT licensed' but says self-hosting needs 'your own RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)' without ever saying that is a paid third-party commercial licence or what it costs. Nothing says who runs app.vendurepos.com, on what terms, or whether it stays free, so the only free path is a hosted app from an unnamed operator.

C7.worst_defect: The SoftwareApplication JSON-LD carries no softwareVersion although the page badge says 'Pre-release · plugin 0.3.0'. Mobile LCP is 2.4 s on / and 2.5 s on /docs/quick-start, with 52 KiB of unused JS flagged.

overall_worst.defect: The 'open-source, MIT licensed' pitch hides a cost. Running the till yourself needs a paid third-party RxDB Premium licence, and the site never says it is paid. The free alternative is app.vendurepos.com, with no word on who operates it, its terms, or its future. A sceptic advising a client reads this as vendor lock-in presented as open source.
